summary: This directory manages milestone-related operations, providing a centralized service for checking, registering, waiting for, and configuring milestones within the business logic domain.
responsibilities: Provide wait mechanisms for milestone completion
relationships: The Milestone Service utilizes the milestone existence result to communicate the status and update history of specific milestones.
designDecisions: Service-oriented architecture to encapsulate milestone business logic
Centralized export strategy through an index file for easier consumption
